decisions: No contact on screen: none was given. The closing card shows the logo, the tagline and 'Reservá tu visita'. Add a number when the client sends it.
Logo: the Termas Concordia logo file was not supplied as a file, so the closing card falls back to the name in type until clients/termas-concordia/assets/logo.png exists.
Family: trail (PathCamera and PathTrail); the user asked for plans A, B and C and no window family.
Photos with a @termasconcordia watermark were cropped at the bottom.
Reel A (light_clock) was discarded by the client: its sun disc did not read as a real sun. Families with a sun or moon disc stay out of this client's work.
Palette: measured from the Bungalows Concordia logo (moss #3F4A38, dusty rose #8F6B6B / #C9A3A3, cream #F6F0E8); the Instagram profile could not be fetched from this session.
